# directus_folder (Data Source)

Reads a Directus folder by id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the folder to look up.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the folder.
- `parent` (String) Parent folder UUID.
